Whisk dry ingredients in a large bowl. 2. In another bowl, beat egg and buttermilk together. 3. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined. 4. Stir in melted butter. 5. Heat a lightly oiled griddle or pan over medium-high heat. 6. Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake. 7. Cook until bubbles form and edges are dry, about 2-3 minutes. 8.
